metadata.name: aera_yield_escrow
metadata.description: Isolated, cancellable receipt escrow paying capped realized reserve yield

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Owner may cancel at any time, including during a reserve pause/loss.
Merchant keeps payments already realized; services can cease on cancel.
Receipt donations belong to the depositor and are returned, not skimmed.

instructions.name: recover_liquidity
docs: Underlying sent directly to the escrow is not merchant yield. The owner
can recover it even after cancellation. Settlement pays only its CPI's
measured balance increase, so there is no pending merchant cash here.

fields.name: admin
docs: The only key that may create markets/reserves, change parameters, or
pause. Rotating it is a deliberate, separate instruction.

fields.name: fee_destination
docs: Where the protocol's whole cut of interest is paid.
One destination, not two: the reserve factor accrues 100% here. A split
would have to be reconciled at every accrual and every payout, and there
is no second beneficiary to reconcile it for.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks every state-changing user instruction except `repay`. Repay is
never blocked: refusing repayment while prices move would manufacture
liquidations the borrower could have avoided.

fields.name: borrow_paused
docs: Blocks new borrows only. Supply, withdraw, repay and liquidate continue.
Set by the admin, and independently by the oracle circuit breaker.

fields.name: param_timelock_seconds
docs: Delay applied to *loosening* parameter changes. Tightening changes and
pauses bypass it entirely.

fields.name: version
docs: Schema version. Absent in v0.1, so a v0.1 account is exactly one byte
shorter than this struct and reads as [`GLOBAL_VERSION_V1`] once
realloc'd and zero-filled.
Declared last on purpose: appending keeps every preceding field at the
offset it already occupies, so the realloc adds a byte rather than
moving anything.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: A queued loosening change. `eta == 0` means "nothing pending".

fields.name: eta
docs: Unix timestamp from which `apply_pending_params` may execute.

fields.name: liquidity_vault
docs: Program-owned token account holding un-borrowed liquidity. Its authority
is this reserve PDA.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: Share-token mint (aCOOK / abCOOK). Mint authority is this reserve PDA.

fields.name: oracle
docs: The [`OracleState`] this reserve prices from.
Renamed from `price_feed` in v0.2. Same offset, same width, so the
account layout is unchanged and existing reserves need no realloc --
migration repoints this at the new oracle account and closes the old
guardian feed.

fields.name: available_liquidity
docs: Base units sitting in `liquidity_vault`. This is the source of truth for
the pool size, not the vault's token balance, so a raw token donation
cannot move the exchange rate.

fields.name: share_mint_supply
docs: Outstanding share supply, mirrored here so valuations need only the
reserve account. A holder burning shares directly via the token program
makes the real supply drift below this mirror; that drift only lowers
what the burner could redeem, so the pool never pays out more than it
holds.

fields.name: borrowed_principal
docs: Total borrowed principal, scaled by the index at borrow time. Live debt
is `borrowed_principal * borrow_index / FIXED_POINT_SCALE`.

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: Monotonically increasing borrow index, FIXED_POINT_SCALE-scaled. Starts
at 1.0 and only ever multiplies by factors >= 1. This is the spec's
`variableBorrowIndex`.

fields.name: accrued_fees
docs: Interest owed to `Global::fee_destination`. Carved out of
`total_liquidity` so it never inflates the supplier exchange rate.

fields.name: pending
docs: A queued *loosening* config change, applied only after its timelock.

types.name: ReserveConfig
docs: Risk, interest and cap parameters. All ratios are basis points.

fields.name: loan_to_value_bps
docs: Fraction of (post-haircut) collateral value a borrower may draw.

fields.name: liquidation_threshold_bps
docs: Above this fraction the obligation may be liquidated.

fields.name: liquidation_bonus_bps
docs: Extra collateral a liquidator receives, as a fraction of value repaid.

fields.name: close_factor_bps
docs: Fraction of a borrow one liquidation may close while HF >= 0.95.

fields.name: collateral_haircut_bps
docs: Discount applied to this asset's collateral value before LTV and LT.
500 (5%) for bCOOK; 0 for an asset marked at face value.

fields.name: optimal_utilization_bps
docs: Utilization at which the borrow rate reaches `optimal_borrow_rate_bps`.

fields.name: min_borrow_rate_bps
docs: Borrow APR at 0% utilization.

fields.name: optimal_borrow_rate_bps
docs: Borrow APR at the kink.

fields.name: max_borrow_rate_bps
docs: Borrow APR at 100% utilization.

fields.name: reserve_factor_bps
docs: Share of interest kept by the protocol, all of it accruing to
`Global::fee_destination`. The rest lifts the supplier exchange rate.

fields.name: origination_fee_bps
docs: One-off fee charged when liquidity is drawn, in basis points of the
amount borrowed. Ships at 0 and is capped at
`MAX_ADMIN_ORIGINATION_FEE_BPS`.
The borrower owes the full amount and receives the amount minus this
fee, which is retained in the vault and recognised immediately as
protocol revenue. Suppliers' claim on the pool is unchanged by it — the
fee comes from the borrower, not from them.

fields.name: supply_cap
docs: Maximum liquidity the reserve will hold. 0 means "no cap".

fields.name: borrow_cap
docs: Maximum liquidity that may be borrowed out. 0 means "no cap".

fields.name: per_wallet_supply_cap
docs: Maximum a single wallet may supply. 0 means "no cap".

fields.name: borrow_enabled
docs: May liquidity be borrowed from this reserve?

fields.name: collateral_enabled
docs: May this reserve's share token be posted as collateral?

fields.name: isolated
docs: Isolated assets may only be paired with other isolated-compatible
collateral. Reserved for a second collateral listing; enforced in
`risk::check_isolation`.

fields.name: slots_per_year
docs: Slots in a year: the divisor turning the APR fields into a per-slot
rate. This is the cluster's slot time expressed as a count, so it is
configuration, not a constant — Cookie Chain's slot time can change, and
a stale value here charges borrowers at the wrong wall-clock rate while
every other number still reads correctly.

errors.name: Math
errors.msg: Arithmetic or reserve accounting is invalid

errors.name: NoRealizableYield
errors.msg: No cash-backed positive return is available
